tools.name: lightcraft_command_list
tools.description: [lightcraft] Every command (engine + UI when connected) with id, label, menu, shortcut, parameter doc and whether it is enabled now. Each id is also callable as tool `cmd_<id with . replaced by _>` or via command_run.

enabled_only.description: Only commands that are enabled now

filter.description: Only commands whose id or label contains this text (case-insensitive)

tools.name: lightcraft_command_run
tools.description: [lightcraft] Run any LightCraft command by id with JSON params (see command_list for ids and parameter docs), e.g. {id: "photo.rate", params: {rating: 4}}.

tools.name: lightcraft_command_batch
tools.description: [lightcraft] Run several commands in order: {steps: [{id, params?}], stop_on_error?: true}. Returns {completed, failed, results: [{ok, result | error}]}.

stop_on_error.description: Stop at the first failing step (default true)

tools.name: lightcraft_doc_inspect
tools.description: [lightcraft] The library as JSON: current source, filter, sort, selection, active photo and undo/redo labels (library.state) plus counts (catalog.stats).

tools.name: lightcraft_render_preview
tools.description: [lightcraft] Render a photo with its current develop settings (cropped) and return it as an image (`max_side` is the long edge; does not change selection or save a file).

format.description: Image encoding (default png; jpeg is smaller)

id.description: Photo id (default: the active photo); selection is unchanged

tools.name: lightcraft_list_commands
tools.description: [lightcraft] Every command (engine + UI when connected) with id, label, menu, shortcut, parameter doc and whether it is enabled now. Each id is also callable as tool `cmd_<id with . replaced by _>` or via run_command.

filter.description: Only commands whose id or label contains this text (case-insensitive)

tools.name: lightcraft_run_command
tools.description: [lightcraft] Run any LightCraft command by id with JSON params (see list_commands for ids and parameter docs), e.g. {command: "photo.rate", params: {rating: 4}}.

tools.name: lightcraft_import
tools.description: [lightcraft] Add image/raw files to the library. Folders are scanned recursively for photos; relative paths resolve against the server's working directory. The first imported photo becomes active. Returns the new photo ids.

album.description: Also add to this album id

mode.description: add (default) = reference the files in place; copy = copy them into `destination` (default: the library's Originals/); move = as copy, then each original and its XMP sidecars are removed from the source once the copy is verified and catalogued (duplicates and failures keep their sources; `kept` lists sources left in place and why; undo leaves the moved files at the destination)

onDeleted.description: A file that is in Recently Deleted: skip (default) = leave it there (the duplicate is reported with existingDeleted); restore = bring the photo back with its edits (`restored` lists it); fresh = delete the trashed record and import the file as a new photo

organize.description: Copy or move: folders inside the destination — date (YYYY/YYYY-MM-DD, default), month (YYYY/YYYY-MM), flat, or a folder template such as {date:%Y}/{date:%Y%m%d} (→ 2026/20260114; the template's / make the levels, tokens as for rename; relative, no ..). Dated by capture time, else the import time

rename.description: Copy or move: file-name template, e.g. {date:%Y%m%d_%H%M%S}_{seq:3} (run_command photo.renameTokens lists the tags); the extension is kept

tools.name: lightcraft_query_photos
tools.description: [lightcraft] List photos (id, file name, size, rating, flag, edited…). Without filter/sort: the current library view.

tools.name: lightcraft_select_photos
tools.description: [lightcraft] Set the selection; the active photo (the one develop tools edit) is `active` or the first id.

tools.name: lightcraft_list_controls
tools.description: [lightcraft] Every develop slider (id like `light.exposure`, label, section, min, max, default, current value) for the active photo.

section.description: Only this section (e.g. light, color, effects, detail)

tools.name: lightcraft_get_develop
tools.description: [lightcraft] The full develop settings JSON of a photo (white balance, light, color, curves, mixer, grading, effects, crop, masks, spots…).

id.description: Photo id (default: the active photo). Makes that photo active first.

tools.name: lightcraft_set_develop
tools.description: [lightcraft] Edit a photo (one undo step each for values and settings). `values` sets sliders by control id (see list_controls), e.g. {"light.exposure": 0.7, "light.contrast": 20}. `settings` deep-merges a partial develop-settings JSON (as returned by get_develop).

id.description: Photo id (default: the active photo). Makes that photo active first.

tools.name: lightcraft_apply_preset
tools.description: [lightcraft] Apply a develop preset (ids from cmd_presets_list) to the selection or `ids`, at `amount` percent (0..200, default 100).

tools.name: lightcraft_crop
tools.description: [lightcraft] Set the crop of the active photo: `rect` [x0,y0,x1,y1] in normalized coordinates (0..1, origin top-left) of the straightened frame, `angle` in degrees. `reset: true` clears it. Give at least one of them.

id.description: Photo id (default: the active photo). Makes that photo active first.

tools.name: lightcraft_render_photo
tools.description: [lightcraft] Render a photo with its current develop settings (cropped) and return it as an image so you can look at the result.

format.description: Image encoding (default png; jpeg is smaller)

id.description: Photo id (default: the active photo). Makes that photo active first.

path.description: Also save the rendered file here

tools.name: lightcraft_export
tools.description: [lightcraft] Render and write photos. Give `path` (one photo; format from the extension unless `format` is set) or `dir` (batch, file names from `naming`).

background.description: Desktop background export (headless exports remain blocking)

bitDepth.description: Bits per channel: PNG 8|16 (default 8), TIFF 8|16|32 (default 16; 32 = linear float with a linear profile), AVIF 8|10; JPEG/WebP are 8-bit

colorSpace.description: Output colour space (default sRGB; AVIF is always sRGB). adobeRgb = Adobe RGB (1998) compatible; the embedded ICC profile is generated from the published primaries

dontEnlarge.description: Never upscale past the photo's own size (default true)

format.description: original = the file as is + an XMP sidecar with the edits; dng = raw photos as DNG with the edits embedded

id.description: Photo id (default: the active photo). Makes that photo active first.

ids.description: Photos to export (default: the given/active photo)

limitKb.description: JPEG: largest quality that fits this many KB

longEdge.description: Output long edge in px. When no size param is given: 3000; 0 = full size (cropped, native resolution)

percent.description: Output size as a percentage of full size

ppi.description: Print resolution written into the file (default 240)

resize.description: Full Resize options; alternatively use the size helpers below

watermark.description: Text, or {text, vertical (boolean; defaults to false: upright columns right to left), size (text height as a fraction of the short edge, 0.005..0.5; default 0.035), opacity (0..1; default 0.7), anchor (topLeft|top|topRight|left|center|right|bottomLeft|bottom|bottomRight), inset (margin as a fraction of the short edge, 0..0.4; default 0.025), color [r,g,b] (sRGB 0..255), shadow (boolean), image (path of a graphic drawn instead of the text), imageWidth (fraction of the photo's width, 0.01..1; default 0.2)}. Unknown keys and out-of-range sizes are errors

width.description: Output width in px (with height: fit inside width × height, either orientation)

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_edit_undo
tools.description: [lightcraft] Undo (command `edit.undo`). Params: {}. Menu: Edit. Shortcut: Cmd+Z.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_edit_redo
tools.description: [lightcraft] Redo (command `edit.redo`). Params: {}. Menu: Edit. Shortcut: Cmd+Shift+Z.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_library_source
tools.description: [lightcraft] Show Source (command `library.source`). Params: {kind: all|recentlyAdded|album|recentlyDeleted|picks|missing|libraryFolder, id?: albumId, path?: a path from library.folders (for libraryFolder)}.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_library_filter
tools.description: [lightcraft] Filter (command `library.filter`). Params: partial Filter: {text?, rating?, ratingOp?: atLeast|exactly|atMost, flag?: pick|reject|none|null, label?, kind?, merged?: hdr|panorama|hdrPanorama|any, edited?, date?, libraryFolder?: a path from library.folders, keyword?, person?, camera?}.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_library_folders
tools.description: [lightcraft] Library Folders (command `library.folders`). Params: {} → [{name, path, count, own, volume, selectable, children}] the disks and the folders the library's photos were imported from, with photo counts (subfolders included in `count`); show one with library.source {kind: libraryFolder, path} (rows with selectable false only open).

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_library_removeFolder
tools.description: [lightcraft] Remove Folder from Library (command `library.removeFolder`). Params: {path, disk?: bool} — move the library photos imported from this folder (and the folders inside it) to Recently Deleted; one undo step, no file is touched. A whole disk or share (`/Volumes/nas`, `C:\`, `\\srv\share`) goes only with `disk: true`, the startup disk never → {removed}.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_library_clearFilter
tools.description: [lightcraft] Clear Filters (command `library.clearFilter`). Params: {}. Menu: View.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_library_sort
tools.description: [lightcraft] Sort (command `library.sort`). Params: {key?: captureDate|importDate|editDate|fileName|rating|fileSize|random, ascending?: bool, group?: auto|none|day|month|year, seed?: u64 (the shuffle `random` gives)}. Menu: View › Sort.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_library_shuffle
tools.description: [lightcraft] Reshuffle (command `library.shuffle`). Params: {seed?: 0..2^53-1} — sort at random; without `seed` a new shuffle each time. Menu: View › Sort.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_library_groups
tools.description: [lightcraft] Date Groups (command `library.groups`). Params: {by?: day|month|year (default: the sort's grouping; auto = day)} → [{key, label, start, count}] date headers of the grid.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_library_select
tools.description: [lightcraft] Select Photos (command `library.select`). Params: {ids: [id], active?: id, mode?: replace|add|toggle|range} — every id must be a photo of the library.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_library_selectAll
tools.description: [lightcraft] Select All (command `library.selectAll`). Params: {}. Menu: Edit. Shortcut: Cmd+A.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_library_devices
tools.description: [lightcraft] Cameras and Cards (command `library.devices`). Params: {} → [{name, path (its DCIM folder), root}] — mounted volumes with a DCIM folder.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_photo_copyMetadata
tools.description: [lightcraft] Copy Metadata (command `photo.copyMetadata`). Params: {} — title, caption, copyright (notice, status, usage terms, info URL), creator, location and keywords of the active photo. Menu: Photo.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_photo_pasteMetadata
tools.description: [lightcraft] Paste Metadata (command `photo.pasteMetadata`). Params: {ids?, fields?: [title|caption|copyright|copyrightStatus|usageTerms|copyrightUrl|creator|location|keywords] (default: all copied)}. Menu: Photo.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_library_selectBy
tools.description: [lightcraft] Select by Flag, Rating or Label (command `library.selectBy`). Params: {flag?: pick|reject|none, rating?: 0..5, ratingOp?: gte|eq|lte (default gte), label?: red|…|none, add?: bool (extend the selection)} — among the photos in view.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_library_selectNone
tools.description: [lightcraft] Deselect All (command `library.selectNone`). Params: {}. Menu: Edit. Shortcut: Cmd+Shift+A.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_library_next
tools.description: [lightcraft] Next Photo (command `library.next`). Params: {}. Shortcut: Right.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_library_previous
tools.description: [lightcraft] Previous Photo (command `library.previous`). Params: {}. Shortcut: Left.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_photo_rate
tools.description: [lightcraft] Set Rating (command `photo.rate`). Params: {rating: 0..5, ids?, advance?: bool}. Menu: Photo › Set Rating.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_photo_flag
tools.description: [lightcraft] Set Flag (command `photo.flag`). Params: {flag: pick|reject|none, ids?, advance?: bool}. Menu: Photo › Set Flag.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_photo_pick
tools.description: [lightcraft] Flag as Pick (command `photo.pick`). Params: {ids?}. Menu: Photo › Set Flag. Shortcut: P.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_photo_reject
tools.description: [lightcraft] Flag as Reject (command `photo.reject`). Params: {ids?}. Menu: Photo › Set Flag. Shortcut: X.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_photo_unflag
tools.description: [lightcraft] Unflag (command `photo.unflag`). Params: {ids?}. Menu: Photo › Set Flag. Shortcut: U.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_photo_label
tools.description: [lightcraft] Set Color Label (command `photo.label`). Params: {label: red|yellow|green|blue|purple|none, ids?}. Menu: Photo › Set Color Label.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_photo_rotateLeft
tools.description: [lightcraft] Rotate Left (command `photo.rotateLeft`). Params: {ids?}. Menu: Photo. Shortcut: Cmd+[.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_photo_rotateRight
tools.description: [lightcraft] Rotate Right (command `photo.rotateRight`). Params: {ids?}. Menu: Photo. Shortcut: Cmd+].

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_photo_flipHorizontal
tools.description: [lightcraft] Flip Horizontal (command `photo.flipHorizontal`). Params: {ids?}. Menu: Photo.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_photo_flipVertical
tools.description: [lightcraft] Flip Vertical (command `photo.flipVertical`). Params: {ids?}. Menu: Photo.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_photo_removeRegion
tools.description: [lightcraft] Remove Face Box (command `photo.removeRegion`). Params: {id?, index} — remove one face / pet region (by its position in the photo's regions) from the photo in the catalog; undoable. The XMP sidecar is never rewritten for this, even with auto-write on, so reading the metadata from the file brings the region back.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_photo_setRegion
tools.description: [lightcraft] Resize Face Box (command `photo.setRegion`). Params: {id?, index, rect: {x0, y0, x1, y1}} — set one face / pet region's box (normalized, in the photo's upright frame; clamped to the photo, at least 0.5 % each way) in the catalog; undoable. Like photo.removeRegion it never rewrites the XMP sidecar.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_photo_delete
tools.description: [lightcraft] Delete Photo (command `photo.delete`). Params: {ids?} — moves to Recently Deleted. Menu: Photo. Shortcut: Delete.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_photo_restore
tools.description: [lightcraft] Restore (command `photo.restore`). Params: {ids?}. Menu: Photo.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_library_emptyRecentlyDeleted
tools.description: [lightcraft] Empty Recently Deleted (command `library.emptyRecentlyDeleted`). Params: {} → {deleted} — removes every photo in Recently Deleted from the library (files on disk stay). Menu: Photo.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_photo_deletePermanently
tools.description: [lightcraft] Delete Permanently (command `photo.deletePermanently`). Params: {ids?}. Menu: Photo.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_photo_setMeta
tools.description: [lightcraft] Edit Info (command `photo.setMeta`). Params: {ids?, title?, caption?, altText?, extendedDescription?, copyright?, copyrightStatus?: unknown|copyrighted|publicDomain, usageTerms?, copyrightUrl?, creator?, location?, city?, state?, country?, gps?: "lat, lon" | [lat, lon] | null, keywords?: [..], addKeywords?: [..], removeKeywords?: [..]}.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_album_create
tools.description: [lightcraft] New Album (command `album.create`). Params: {name, parent?: folderId, folder?: bool, addSelected?: bool}. Menu: File.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_album_createSmart
tools.description: [lightcraft] New Smart Album… (command `album.createSmart`). Params: {name, rules?: partial Filter (rating, ratingOp, flag, label, kind, edited, keyword, camera, lens, dateFrom, dateTo, date, text, album, ruleSet: {match: all|any|none, rules: [{field, op, value} | {group: ruleSet}]} — see album.ruleFields), parent?: folderId} — without `rules`, saves the current view (source + filter).

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_album_ruleFields
tools.description: [lightcraft] Smart Album Rule Fields (command `album.ruleFields`). Params: {} → [{field, label, kind, ops: [{op, label}], choices?}] for ruleSet rules.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_album_setRules
tools.description: [lightcraft] Edit Smart Album (command `album.setRules`). Params: {id, rules?: partial Filter merged onto the current rules (null clears a field), replace?: bool, fromView?: bool (use the current view)}.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_album_rename
tools.description: [lightcraft] Rename Album (command `album.rename`). Params: {id, name}.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_album_delete
tools.description: [lightcraft] Delete Album (command `album.delete`). Params: {id}.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_album_move
tools.description: [lightcraft] Move Album (command `album.move`). Params: {id, parent?: folderId|null}.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_album_reorder
tools.description: [lightcraft] Reorder Album (command `album.reorder`). Params: {id, parent?: folderId|null, before?: albumId|null} — places the album (or folder) in `parent` (default: where it is; null: the top level) before the sibling `before` of the same kind, or last of its kind; the folder is then ordered by hand. One undo step. → {changed}: how many edits it took (0: already there).

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_album_sort
tools.description: [lightcraft] Sort Albums by Name (command `album.sort`). Params: {parent?: folderId|null} — drops the hand order of the albums inside the folder (default: the top level), so they are listed by name → {changed}: how many albums lost their place.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_album_addPhotos
tools.description: [lightcraft] Add to Album (command `album.addPhotos`). Params: {id: albumId, ids?: [photoIds]} (default: selection). Menu: Photo.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_album_toggleTarget
tools.description: [lightcraft] Add to Target Album (command `album.toggleTarget`). Params: {ids?} — B: adds the photos to the target album (the Quick Collection unless one is set), or removes them when they're all in it → {album, added}.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_album_setTarget
tools.description: [lightcraft] Set as Target Album (command `album.setTarget`). Params: {id: albumId | null} (null = the Quick Collection).

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_album_clearQuick
tools.description: [lightcraft] Clear Quick Collection (command `album.clearQuick`). Params: {}.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_library_autoImport
tools.description: [lightcraft] Auto Import Settings (command `library.autoImport`). Params: {folder?: path | null (off), copy?: bool (copy into the library's Originals, else add in place), album?: name | null} — a watched folder whose new photos are added as they arrive (library.autoImportScan; the app scans every few seconds) → the settings.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_library_autoImportScan
tools.description: [lightcraft] Auto Import Now (command `library.autoImportScan`). Params: {listing?: [[path, size]] (the folder as listed by the caller, e.g. on a worker thread), start?: bool (false: return the `library.import` params as `import` instead of importing)} — add the watched folder's new photos (files the library doesn't have yet; partial / still-copying files wait for the next scan) → {imported, folder, import?}.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_album_removePhotos
tools.description: [lightcraft] Remove from Album (command `album.removePhotos`). Params: {id: albumId, ids?}.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_album_setCover
tools.description: [lightcraft] Set as Album Cover (command `album.setCover`). Params: {id: albumId, photo?: photoId}.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_library_inspectLightroom
tools.description: [lightcraft] Inspect Lightroom Catalog (command `library.inspectLightroom`). Params: {path: .lrcat} → {photos, collections, missing, warnings}; read-only, no Lightroom required.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_library_importLightroom
tools.description: [lightcraft] Import Lightroom Catalog (command `library.importLightroom`). Params: {path: .lrcat, updateExisting?: false}; direct import of paths, ratings, flags, metadata, keywords, collections, virtual copies & mapped edits. Archives source settings/history first. Existing edited photos are preserved unless updateExisting=true; source catalog is read-only..

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_library_importPreview
tools.description: [lightcraft] Review Import (command `library.importPreview`). Params: {paths: [file or folder (recursive)]} → {candidates: [{path, name, format, kind, width, height, fileSize, captured, duplicate?: path|content, existing?, error?, previewOnly?: why a raw can only be shown from its embedded preview}], duplicates, scanned} — nothing is added.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_library_import
tools.description: [lightcraft] Import Photos (command `library.import`). Params: {paths: [file or folder (recursive)], mode?: add|copy|move (add = reference the files in place; copy = into the library's Originals/YYYY/YYYY-MM-DD/; move = as copy, then each original and its XMP sidecars are removed from the source — only after the copy is verified (a hard link on the same volume, else copied, synced and compared byte for byte) and its catalog record is saved; failed, duplicate and unchecked files keep their sources; a taken name gets -1, -2…; undo removes the photos from the library but leaves the files at the destination), destination?: folder for copies / moves, organize?: date (YYYY/YYYY-MM-DD) | month (YYYY/YYYY-MM) | flat | a folder template, e.g. `{date:%Y}/{date:%Y%m%d}` → 2026/20260114 (the template's `/` make the folders, each level expanded with the rename tokens and made a safe folder name: never outside the destination; must be relative, no `..`; a level with missing metadata is `unknown`) — dated by capture time, else the import time, rename?: file-name template for copies, original extension added (tokens: {name} {num} {seq} {seq:N} {date} {date:%Y%m%d} {folder} {camera} {lens} {iso} {rating} {title} {creator} {ext}; photo.renameTokens explains each; blank = keep names), renameStart?: 1, metadataPreset?: name, dng?: bool (copy raws as DNG; copy only), local?: bool (browsing: the photos stay out of the library, like library.browse; not with move), album?: albumId, albumName?: new album, preset?: presetId, keywords?: [..], onDeleted?: skip|restore|fresh (a file that is in Recently Deleted: skip = leave it there and say so, restore = bring the photo back with its edits, fresh = delete the trashed record and import the file as new)} → {imported, duplicates: [{path, existing, reason, existingDeleted?}], restored?: [photoId], failed, moved?: [{from, to, sidecars?}], kept?: [{path, reason}] (move: sources left in place and why), album?}. Menu: File. Shortcut: Cmd+Shift+I.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_library_info
tools.description: [lightcraft] Library Info (command `library.info`). Params: {}.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_library_compact
tools.description: [lightcraft] Optimize Library (command `library.compact`). Params: {}. Menu: File.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_library_clearPreviews
tools.description: [lightcraft] Clear Preview Cache (command `library.clearPreviews`). Params: {}. Menu: File.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_develop_set
tools.description: [lightcraft] Set Develop Values (command `develop.set`). Params: {control?: controlId, value?: number, values?: {controlId: number}, ids?: [photo]} — see develop.controls.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_develop_adjust
tools.description: [lightcraft] Nudge Develop Value (command `develop.adjust`). Params: {control, delta}.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_develop_merge
tools.description: [lightcraft] Apply Settings JSON (command `develop.merge`). Params: {settings: partial DevelopSettings JSON, label?}.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_develop_reset
tools.description: [lightcraft] Reset Edits (command `develop.reset`). Params: {ids?}. Menu: Photo. Shortcut: Cmd+Shift+R.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_develop_resetSection
tools.description: [lightcraft] Reset Section (command `develop.resetSection`). Params: {section: light|curve|color|mixer|grading|effects|vignette|grain|detail|optics|geometry}.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_develop_resetControl
tools.description: [lightcraft] Reset Control (command `develop.resetControl`). Params: {control}.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_develop_sectionEnabled
tools.description: [lightcraft] Toggle Section (command `develop.sectionEnabled`). Params: {section: string, enabled: bool}.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_develop_autoBwMix
tools.description: [lightcraft] Auto B&W Mix (command `develop.autoBwMix`). Params: {} — sets the black & white mix from the photo's colours (and switches to B&W).

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_develop_auto
tools.description: [lightcraft] Auto Settings (command `develop.auto`). Params: {}. Menu: Photo. Shortcut: Shift+A.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_develop_wb
tools.description: [lightcraft] White Balance (command `develop.wb`). Params: {mode: asShot|auto|daylight|cloudy|shade|tungsten|fluorescent|flash|custom, temp?, tint?}.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_develop_wbPick
tools.description: [lightcraft] White Balance Selector (command `develop.wbPick`). Params: {x, y} normalized image coords of a neutral point. Shortcut: W.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_develop_treatment
tools.description: [lightcraft] Black & White (command `develop.treatment`). Params: {bw?: bool} (toggles when omitted). Menu: Photo. Shortcut: V.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_develop_profile
tools.description: [lightcraft] Set Profile (command `develop.profile`). Params: {id: profile id (see profiles.list), amount?: 0..200}.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_profile_favorite
tools.description: [lightcraft] Favorite Profile (command `profile.favorite`). Params: {id, favorite?: bool} (toggles when omitted).

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_develop_curve
tools.description: [lightcraft] Set Point Curve (command `develop.curve`). Params: {channel: master|red|green|blue, points: [[x,y],...] in 0..1}.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_crop_set
tools.description: [lightcraft] Set Crop (command `crop.set`). Params: {rect?: [x0,y0,x1,y1] normalized in the straightened frame, angle?: degrees}.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_crop_drag
tools.description: [lightcraft] Drag Crop Handle (command `crop.drag`). Params: {handle: topLeft|topRight|bottomRight|bottomLeft|top|right|bottom|left|move | 0..8, from: [x,y], to: [x,y] (normalized, straightened frame), start?: [x0,y0,x1,y1] (default: the current crop)} — drags a crop handle; stops at the image edge, keeps the opposite edges, honours the aspect lock.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_crop_straighten
tools.description: [lightcraft] Straighten (command `crop.straighten`). Params: {angle: degrees -45..45} — keeps the largest crop of the current aspect.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_crop_autoStraighten

tools.description: [lightcraft] List History (command `history.list`). Params: {id?}.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_app_gpu
tools.description: [lightcraft] GPU Rendering (command `app.gpu`). tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_library_memory
tools.description: [lightcraft] Memory Usage (command `library.memory`). Params: {} — bytes held by each cache (decoded sources, rendered previews, GPU buffers; heap when instrumented).

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_app_memoryBudget
tools.description: [lightcraft] Memory Budget (command `app.memoryBudget`). Params: {mb?: number} — set the memory budget shared by the caches (default: a quarter of RAM, at most 1536 MB); returns the report.

tools.description: [lightcraft] Command Journal (command `journal.list`). Params: {limit?}.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_photo_saveMetadataToFile
tools.description: [lightcraft] Save Metadata to File (command `photo.saveMetadataToFile`). tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_photo_readMetadataFromFile
tools.description: [lightcraft] Read Metadata from File (command `photo.readMetadataFromFile`). Params: {ids?} — reads each photo's XMP sidecar (or a raw/DNG's embedded XMP): metadata and develop settings, one undo step → {read, failed}. Menu: Photo.

tools.description: [lightcraft] Import Presets (command `preset.import`). tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_preset_export
tools.description: [lightcraft] Export Presets (command `preset.export`). Params: {path, ids?: [presetId], group?: name} (default: all user presets) → {path, count}; writes a .lcpreset JSON file.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_library_preferences
tools.description: [lightcraft] Library Preferences (command `library.preferences`). Params: {import?: {rawPreset?: presetId|"default", otherPreset?: presetId|"default", perCamera?: bool, cameras?: [{camera: "Make Model", preset: presetId|null}], copyright?: text, creator?: text (given to imported photos without one)}, camera?: {camera, preset?, remove?: bool}, cacheMb?: n (0 = default), forgetLocalDays?: n (forget untouched Local photos of folders not browsed for n days; 0 = never)} — develop defaults applied on import (raws / other images / per camera) and the thumbnail cache size, saved with the library → {xmp, import, cacheMb, forgetLocalDays, persistent}.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_export_presets
tools.description: [lightcraft] Export Presets (command `export.presets`). Params: {} → [{name, builtin, params}] (use with app.export {preset: name, …overrides}).

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_export_savePreset
tools.description: [lightcraft] Save Export Preset (command `export.savePreset`). Params: {name, params?: app.export params (default: the last export's)} — adds or replaces a user preset, saved with the library → presets.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_export_deletePreset
tools.description: [lightcraft] Delete Export Preset (command `export.deletePreset`). Params: {name} — removes a user preset → presets.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_export_checkTarget
tools.description: [lightcraft] Check Output Path (command `export.checkTarget`). Params: {path} — fails when writing `path` would replace a photo's original (or its XMP sidecar) in the library; front ends call it before saving a render or screenshot to a user-given path → {path}.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_beforeAfter_setBefore
tools.description: [lightcraft] Set Before (command `beforeAfter.setBefore`). Params: {source: import|current|history|version, index? (history step), name? (version)} — what the before side shows (this session).

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_beforeAfter_copyAfterToBefore
tools.description: [lightcraft] Copy After's Settings to Before (command `beforeAfter.copyAfterToBefore`). Params: {}. Menu: View › Before/After Settings.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_beforeAfter_copyBeforeToAfter

tools.description: [lightcraft] Swap Before and After Settings (command `beforeAfter.swap`). Params: {}. Menu: View › Before/After Settings.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_beforeAfter_resetBefore
tools.description: [lightcraft] Reset Before to Import State (command `beforeAfter.resetBefore`). Params: {}. Menu: View › Before/After Settings.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_folder_rename
tools.description: [lightcraft] Rename Folder (command `folder.rename`). Params: {path, name} — rename a folder on disk (its files and sidecars go along) and relink the photos in it; one undo step (undo renames it back, refused if the old name is taken) → {path, relinked}.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_folder_move
tools.description: [lightcraft] Move Folder (command `folder.move`). Params: {path, into: destination folder} — move a folder on disk into another and relink the photos in it; one undo step (undo moves it back, refused if the old place is taken) → {path, relinked}.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_library_browse
tools.description: [lightcraft] Browse Folder (command `library.browse`). Params: {path, subfolders?: bool} — show a folder's photos without adding them to the library (they're read in place; edits go to XMP sidecars) → {path, photos, new}.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_library_forgetLocal
tools.description: [lightcraft] Forget Unchanged Local Photos (command `library.forgetLocal`). Params: {dryRun?: bool, days?: n (default: the library preference, 0 = never)} — remove Local (browsed, not added) photos nobody changed, of folders not browsed for `days`, from the catalog; files and sidecars stay, browsing the folder again brings them back; not an undo step → {local, forgotten, keptRecent, keptTouched, keptInUse, foldersStamped, days, dryRun}.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_photo_addToLibrary
tools.description: [lightcraft] Add to My Photos (command `photo.addToLibrary`). Params: {ids?} — browsed (Local) photos join the library. Menu: Photo.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_library_missing
tools.description: [lightcraft] Missing Photos (command `library.missing`). Params: {} → [{id, path}] — photos whose original file isn't where the library expects it.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_photo_relink
tools.description: [lightcraft] Locate Photo (command `photo.relink`). Params: {id?, path} — point a photo at its file's new location (undo never moves files).

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_library_findMissing
tools.description: [lightcraft] Find Missing Photos (command `library.findMissing`). Params: {folder} — relink every missing photo whose file is somewhere in the folder: same name and size (and content, when the library knows its hash), or — renamed — same size and content; or {found, missing, ambiguous} — relink what a search already found (the app searches on a worker thread; photos relinked meanwhile and files now in use are skipped) → {found: [{id, from, to, by: name|content}], missing, ambiguous: [{id, from, candidates}] (several same-name candidates and no hash to tell them apart: skipped)}.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_metadata_presets
tools.description: [lightcraft] Metadata Presets (command `metadata.presets`). Params: {} → [{name, fields}].

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_metadata_savePreset
tools.description: [lightcraft] Save Metadata Preset (command `metadata.savePreset`). Params: {name, fields?: {copyright?, copyrightStatus?: unknown|copyrighted|publicDomain, usageTerms?, copyrightUrl?, creator?, title?, caption?, location?, city?, state?, country?, keywords?: [..]}, only?: [field] (from the active photo when `fields` is absent; default the copyright fields, creator, place)} — adds or replaces.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_metadata_deletePreset
tools.description: [lightcraft] Delete Metadata Preset (command `metadata.deletePreset`). Params: {name}.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_metadata_applyPreset
tools.description: [lightcraft] Apply Metadata Preset (command `metadata.applyPreset`). Params: {name, ids?} — text fields replace, keywords are added; one undo step.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_filter_presets
tools.description: [lightcraft] Filter Presets (command `filter.presets`). Params: {} → [{name, filter}].

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_filter_savePreset
tools.description: [lightcraft] Save Filter Preset (command `filter.savePreset`). Params: {name} — the current filter (library.filter), saved with the library.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_filter_applyPreset
tools.description: [lightcraft] Apply Filter Preset (command `filter.applyPreset`). Params: {name} — replaces the current filter → {photos}.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_filter_deletePreset
tools.description: [lightcraft] Delete Filter Preset (command `filter.deletePreset`). Params: {name}.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_denoise_models_list
tools.description: [lightcraft] Denoise Models (command `denoise.models.list`). Params: {} → {dir, productsDir, model, runtime, auto, cacheGb, threads, runOn, models: [{id, name, version, licence{name, commercial, url, notice}, provenance, source, sizeBytes, sha256, tile, known, downloadHost, installed, selected, accepted}]}.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_denoise_models_inspect
tools.description: [lightcraft] Inspect Denoise Model (command `denoise.models.inspect`). Params: {path} → model terms from an adjacent manifest; never executes the file.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_denoise_models_install
tools.description: [lightcraft] Install Denoise Model (command `denoise.models.install`). Params: {path, acknowledged: true, activate?: true, background?: false} → {installed, model} or {started} — install a denoise model from a file: an .onnx with a denoise-model.json beside it, or an archive LightCraft knows (the darktable `.dtmodel`). `acknowledged` must be true: the user has been shown the model's licence and accepted it. Unless `activate` is false it becomes the model in use.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_denoise_models_download
tools.description: [lightcraft] Download Denoise Model (command `denoise.models.download`). Params: {id, acknowledged: true} → {started, from} — fetch a model LightCraft has a pinned address for (see `downloadHost` in the list) in the background over HTTPS with lightcraft-fetch. `acknowledged` must be true: the user has been shown the model's terms and accepted them. It is checked against its size and SHA-256, installed and chosen by itself; `denoise.models.downloads` shows how far it is.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_denoise_models_downloads
tools.description: [lightcraft] Denoise Model Downloads (command `denoise.models.downloads`). Params: {} → {running, downloads: [{id, state: running | done | installed | failed | cancelled, bytes, total, error, from}]} — also installs any download that has arrived.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_denoise_models_downloadCancel
tools.description: [lightcraft] Cancel Denoise Model Download (command `denoise.models.downloadCancel`). Params: {id} → {discarded} — stop a download, or delete a finished one that was not installed.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_denoise_models_test
tools.description: [lightcraft] Test Denoise Model (command `denoise.models.test`). Params: {id} → {ok, result} — load an installed model and check it gives sensible pictures; needs the denoise runtime.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_denoise_models_remove
tools.description: [lightcraft] Remove Denoise Model (command `denoise.models.remove`). Params: {id} → {removed, model} — delete an installed model (its cached pictures stay until they are evicted).

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_denoise_models_select
tools.description: [lightcraft] Choose Denoise Model (command `denoise.models.select`). Params: {id: installed model | null} → {model} — null switches denoise off.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_denoise_settings
tools.description: [lightcraft] Denoise Settings (command `denoise.settings`). Params: {auto?: bool, cacheGb?: 1..10000, threads?: 1..64 | null, runOn?: auto | gpu | cpu} → the settings — `auto`: make the picture of the photos being looked at that have a Denoise amount; `cacheGb`: how much the cached pictures may take; `threads`: most tiles run at once; `runOn`: where the model runs — `auto` (the default) the graphics card where it is faster than the processor (both timed on this computer when the card is set up), `gpu` the card whenever it can run the model, `cpu` the processor. Setting `runOn` also lets the card be tried again after a set-up that failed or closed LightCraft.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_denoise_toggle
tools.description: [lightcraft] AI Denoise (command `denoise.toggle`). Params: {id?: photoId, enabled?: bool} → {id, enabled, amount} — turn AI Denoise on (50% initially) or off for one raw photo, independent of selection and Auto Sync; needs an installed model to turn on.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_denoise_queue
tools.description: [lightcraft] Denoise Photos (command `denoise.queue`). Params: {ids?: [photoId], scope?: selected | visible | withAmount, retry?: false} → {added, …status} — make the denoised pictures of raw photos that have none, in the background. `retry` tries photos that failed before.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_denoise_cancel
tools.description: [lightcraft] Cancel Denoise (command `denoise.cancel`). Params: {id?, all?} → {cancelled} — stop the photo being made and/or forget the ones waiting (all of them when `id` is omitted).

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_denoise_status
tools.description: [lightcraft] Denoise Status (command `denoise.status`). Params: {id?} → {enabled, model, runtime, productsDir, queued, running: {photo, done, total, seconds} | null, ready, made, auto, runOn, device: {kind: gpu | cpu | pending | none, adapter?, reason?, cardMs?, cpuMs?, fellBack?}, cache: {files, bytes, limitBytes}, generation, photo?: {state: notApplicable | noModel | ready | queued | running | failed | idle, …}}.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_denoise_pump
tools.description: [lightcraft] Denoise Pump (command `denoise.pump`). Params: {pace?: pause | light | normal | full} → {active, running, queued, ready, generation, downloading} — called every frame by the app: takes in finished work and keeps one photo going.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_denoise_clear
tools.description: [lightcraft] Clear Denoise Cache (command `denoise.clear`). Params: {} → {deleted, bytes} — delete every cached denoised picture of this library (they are made again when wanted).

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_faces_models_list
tools.description: [lightcraft] Face Models (command `faces.models.list`). Params: {} → {dir, enabled, embedder, runtime, models: [{id, name, role, licence{name, commercial, url, notice}, provenance, source, sizeBytes, known, installed, selected}]}.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_faces_models_inspect
tools.description: [lightcraft] Inspect Face Model File (command `faces.models.inspect`). Params: {path} → what a .onnx file is: {kind: known | draft | unsupported, model, assumptions, reason, alreadyInstalled}; installs nothing.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_faces_models_install
tools.description: [lightcraft] Install Face Model (command `faces.models.install`). Params: {path, acknowledged: true, activate?: true} → {installed, active: {embedder, enabled}} — copy a .onnx face recognition model into the models folder. `acknowledged` must be true: the user has been shown its licence (see inspect) and accepted it. Unless `activate` is false the model becomes the one in use and recognition is switched on; an earlier model stays installed.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_faces_models_download
tools.description: [lightcraft] Download Face Model (command `faces.models.download`). Params: {id, acknowledged: true} → {started, from} — fetch a recognition model LightCraft has a pinned address for (see `downloadHost` in the list), in the background over pure-Rust https (lightcraft-fetch). `acknowledged` must be true: the user has been shown the model's terms and accepted them. It is checked against its size and SHA-256, then installed, chosen and switched on by itself; `faces.models.downloads` shows how far it is.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_faces_models_downloads
tools.description: [lightcraft] Face Model Downloads (command `faces.models.downloads`). Params: {} → {running, downloads: [{id, state: running | done | installed | failed | cancelled, bytes, total, error, from}]} — also installs any download that has arrived; `installed` stays listed until `faces.models.downloadCancel` clears it.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_faces_models_downloadCancel
tools.description: [lightcraft] Cancel Face Model Download (command `faces.models.downloadCancel`). Params: {id} → {discarded} — stop a download, or delete a finished one that was not installed.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_faces_models_test
tools.description: [lightcraft] Test Face Model (command `faces.models.test`). Params: {id} → {ok, result: {loadMs, embedMs, dimension, checks}} — load an installed recognition model and check it gives sensible faces; needs the recognition runtime.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_faces_models_remove
tools.description: [lightcraft] Remove Face Model (command `faces.models.remove`). Params: {id} — delete an installed model.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_faces_models_select
tools.description: [lightcraft] Choose Face Recognition Model (command `faces.models.select`). Params: {id: installed recogniser | null}.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_faces_enable
tools.description: [lightcraft] Face Recognition On/Off (command `faces.enable`). Params: {enabled?: bool} (toggles when omitted).

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_faces_detect
tools.description: [lightcraft] Detect Faces (command `faces.detect`). Params: {ids?, apply?: bool (default true), score?: 0.6, nmsIou?: 0.3, maxFaces?} → {photos: [{id, faces: [{rect, score, landmarks}]}]}. Finds faces with the YuNet detector (download it first: `faces.models.download {id: "yunet-2023mar"}`) and, unless `apply` is false, adds them as unnamed face regions (one undo step), replacing earlier detections but never regions from XMP or ones you named; the sidecar is not touched. Menu: Photo.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_faces_index
tools.description: [lightcraft] Index Faces (command `faces.index`). Params: {budgetMs?: 200, ids?: [photo ids to do first]} → {embedded, photosDone, pendingPhotos, indexedFaces, ms} — embed the faces in the library with the chosen recognition model, as many photos as fit in the time (at least one); call again until `pendingPhotos` is 0. `budgetMs: 0` only reports.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_faces_suggest
tools.description: [lightcraft] Suggest Names for Faces (command `faces.suggest`). Params: {ids?, threshold?, margin?, budgetMs?} → {photos: [{id, faces: [{index, suggestion: {name, score, runnerUp} | null, candidates: [{name, score}]}]}]} — who the unnamed faces in these photos might be, from the faces already named in the library. Only suggestions: nothing is named.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_faces_pump
tools.description: [lightcraft] Index Faces in the Background (command `faces.pump`). Params: {pace?: pause | light | normal | full} → {active, inFlight, pendingPhotos, indexedFaces, searchedPhotos, workers} — cheap to call every frame: takes in what the background workers have finished and gives them the next photos, as many at once as the pace allows (none when paused, one when light, half the machine's threads when normal, four fifths when full); inactive until face recognition is on in Settings with a model chosen.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_faces_evaluate
tools.description: [lightcraft] Evaluate Face Recognition (command `faces.evaluate`). Params: {budgetMs?: 0, burstSecs?: 5, margin?, thresholds?: [..], scope?: "visible"} → {queries, top1, sweep: [{threshold, suggested, correct, precision, recall}]} — leave-one-out over your named faces: each is ranked against the others (ignoring shots within burstSecs of it) to show how well the chosen model recognises people in *your* photos and which threshold to trust. Faces not yet embedded are done within budgetMs (`faces.index` does them all); counts only.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_faces_unnamed
tools.description: [lightcraft] Unnamed Faces (command `faces.unnamed`). Params: {limit?: 600} → {total, faces: [{photo, index, rect, view, suggestion: {name, score} | null}], ordered, ready} — the faces nobody has named; with recognition running, look-alikes are next to each other and a face the named ones recognise carries the name they suggest. `view` is the box to show the face by. Name them with `faces.nameFaces`.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_faces_nameFaces
tools.description: [lightcraft] Name Faces (command `faces.nameFaces`). Params: {faces: [{photo, index}], name} → {named, photos} — name (or, with a null or empty name, clear) many face regions as one undoable step; the sidecar is not touched.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_faces_person
tools.description: [lightcraft] Faces of a Person (command `faces.person`). Params: {name, more?: 120} → {name, total, confirmed: [{photo, index, rect}], more: [{photo, index, rect, score}], ready, pendingPhotos} — the faces named `name` across the library, and the unnamed faces that look most like them (best first, already embedded ones only, once recognition is on); confirm one with `faces.setName`.

tools.name: lightcraft_cmd_faces_setName
tools.description: [lightcraft] Name Face (command `faces.setName`). Params: {id?, index, name} — name a face region (null or empty clears it); undoable; the sidecar is not touched.
